hero.title: About Job Search AI
hero.subtitle: We put artificial intelligence at the service of candidates to make job searching faster, fairer and less stressful.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Searching for a job is time-consuming and often discouraging. Job Search AI automates repetitive tasks — reading offers, sorting, personalizing applications — so you can focus on what really matters: getting the right interviews.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.text: Our platform analyzes your resume, semantically compares it to thousands of offers and highlights those that actually match your profile. It then helps you prepare for your interviews and track your applications in one place.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: you stay in control of your data and your applications.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.text: matching based on meaning, not just keywords.

cta.title: Start Now
cta.text: Upload your resume and let AI find the offers made for you.

hero.title: Contact Us

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Job Search AI.

matching.question: How does matching between my resume and job offers work?
matching.answer: We analyze the content of your resume and compare it semantically to the offers: the AI evaluates the meaning, not just keywords, to highlight positions truly adapted to your profile.

security.question: Is my data safe?
security.answer: Your data is never sold. It is only used to provide you with the service (resume analysis, matching, application tracking) and you can request its deletion at any time.

price.question: Is the service free?
price.answer: You can upload your resume and run your first searches for free. Advanced features may be offered later.

formats.question: What resume formats can I upload?
formats.answer: You can upload a resume in PDF format. The text is automatically analyzed to extract your skills and experience.

interview.question: How does the assistant help me prepare for an interview?
interview.answer: The assistant simulates questions adapted to the target offer and your background, then gives you feedback to improve your answers before the real interview.
